Additional sampler controls

Source: R/sampler_control.R
sampler_control.Rd

Pass this object as control to pdmp_sample(), pdmp_sample_from_stanmodel() or brm_pdmp(). Settings apply to that call only, including when a worker is reused for another model.

Usage

sampler_control(
  grid_n_min = NULL,
  grid_bound_violation = NULL,
  adaptive_boomerang_refresh_rate = 0.1,
  warmup_stop = NULL,
  profile = FALSE,
  research_diagnostics = FALSE,
  hcv_cache = TRUE,
  check_fast_deterministic = FALSE
)

Arguments

grid_n_min

Minimum grid size, or NULL for min(grid_n, 5).

grid_bound_violation

Grid bound violation policy: NULL uses the sampler default; otherwise "throw", "shrink", or "count".

adaptive_boomerang_refresh_rate

Initial refresh rate for adaptive Boomerang dynamics. The default is 0.1.

warmup_stop

Optional named list configuring adaptive warmup stopping: min_time, max_time, stable_time, min_events, and check_every. An empty list enables defaults (one quarter, all, and one quarter of t_warmup, 100 events, and a check every 25 events); NULL disables it. Supported by custom-Stan sampling.

profile

Collect bridge-phase timings for custom-Stan sampling.

research_diagnostics

Collect additional OMRF allocation and HVP timing diagnostics. These measurements add overhead.

hcv_cache

Reuse OMRF Hessian products along a flight.

check_fast_deterministic

Compare the fast OMRF deterministic gradient with its generic evaluation. Intended for diagnostics; adds overhead.

Value

A sampler control list.
